abstract:
Abstract
                  We shine a spotlight on marketing misinformation—claims about products and brands that contradict or distort verifiable facts. Misinformation may be created unintentionally or intentionally by companies, competitors, customers, or third parties seeking to harm companies or consumers. We focus on the role of AI in creating, obfuscating, and disseminating misinformation in the form of text, audio, images, and videos generated using large language models. This type of information can pose a substantial risk for brand safety. Consumers may be aware that AI can generate misinformation but may lack the ability to guard against it. We discuss how different stakeholders in the information ecosystem can help in the prevention and correction of misinformation and propose a future research agenda in this critical and fast‐growing area.

ob.tldr: 聚焦AI时代营销误导信息问题，系统讨论由大语言模型生成的文本、音频、图像与视频如何被企业、竞争对手、消费者或第三方用于制造、混淆与传播虚假品牌和产品信息，分析其对品牌安全的风险及消费者识别能力不足的现状，并从信息生态中各方利益相关者角度提出预防与纠正框架及未来研究方向。
